entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel protector of Innistrad, imprisoned within the Helvault by her own weapon.

entities.name: the Helvault
entities.description: A moon-silver prison intended to restrain indestructible diabolical creatures; it now holds Avacyn.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon who challenged Avacyn and turned the Helvault against her, then fell into it himself.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane of four provinces beset by monsters, left without its protector.

entities.name: Avacynian Church
entities.description: The church of Avacyn, whose clergy keep her absence secret while its authority fails.

entities.name: Mikaeus, the Lunarch
entities.description: The highest-ranking priest of the Church, who made witnesses swear to secrecy.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The High City in Gavony, site of Thraben Cathedral and the Helvault.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: A province where vampire families are in a dark renaissance.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A province plagued by ghoulcallers, skaberen and geists.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: A province where werewolves and geists have ruined agriculture.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: The province home to Thraben and the Helvault.

entities.name: Skirsdag Cult
entities.description: A demon-worshipping cult whose ranks are growing.

entities.name: Bishop Volpaig
entities.description: A crude-minded minor bishop of the Church secretly working for the Skirsdag.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: A millennia-old vampire planeswalker who created Avacyn and fears a world absent of humans.

entities.name: Liliana
entities.description: A planeswalker who needed demonic help to ensure her lasting power and youth.

events.summary: Griselbrand turns the Helvault against Avacyn, trapping her inside and leaving Innistrad without a protector.
events.quote: The demon Griselbrand challenged Avacyn and turned the tables at the last moment

events.summary: Mikaeus makes the witnesses swear to secrecy and the Church conceals Avacyn's fate.
events.quote: made those few priests who had witnessed the tragedy swear to secrecy

events.summary: Vampires of Stensia take up residence among humans and kill cathars as the Church's authority fails.
events.quote: the authority of the Avacynian Church is failing here, and fast

events.summary: Bishop Volpaig, secretly a Skirsdag servant, learns that his master Griselbrand has fallen into the Helvault and grows more open about his allegiance.
events.quote: has overheard that his master Griselbrand has fallen into the Helvault

relations.note: He challenged her and imprisoned her in the Helvault.
